description:
The posters come in two sizes  which are 8 1/2 x 11 inches and 4 1/4 x 5 1/2 inches.

They come in 5 different colors and have 20 unique messages.

Are you looking for the perfect way to spread positivity and motivation to your loved ones in hospitals, care centers, or nursing homes? Look no further! Presenting "Inspirational Posters & Cards" - a collection of vibrant and inspiring posters and cards that will bring a burst of joy to any space.

Our original collection features 20 unique messages, carefully crafted to uplift spirits, spark hope, and encourage a positive mindset. Each poster or card is thoughtfully designed with bright and captivating colors that instantly catch the eye and create an atmosphere of positivity.

With our convenient adhesive backing, hanging these posters is a breeze. Simply use the enclosed stickers / labels to adhere to any wall, mirror, or door, instantly transforming any space into an oasis of motivation. The adhesive is gentle enough to ensure easy removal without leaving any residue, making it a perfect solution for temporary displays.

Why choose these posters for your loved ones? Here's why:

  1. Spreading Happiness: Bring smiles to the faces of your friends, family, or anyone who needs a boost of positivity. Our posters and cards are a perfect gift for those in hospitals, care centers, or nursing homes, where a little inspiration can make a big difference.

  2. Eye-Catching Designs: The bold colors and uplifting messages combine to create a visually striking and emotionally impactful experience.

  3. Easy to Use: Hanging these posters is as easy as 1-2-3! The included adhesive  ensures hassle-free application and removal, allowing you to decorate any space effortlessly without having to go search for the masking tape!

  4. Thoughtful Messages: Each poster and card in our collection is carefully curated to deliver powerful and empowering messages. These simple heartfelt affirmations are words of encouragement that will touch hearts and inspire positive thinking.

  5. Versatile Gifting: These are not just for hospitals and care facilities. They are also perfect for gifting on birthdays, graduations, or any occasion when you want to show your support and share positivity.

Believe me, these posters WILL make a difference to those you share them with. I have been making and giving this product to family memebers and people I know for several years.  Our posters and cards are designed to spread hope, foster resilience, and remind people that they are never alone in their daily journey.

Don't miss the opportunity to make a lasting impact on the lives of your loved ones. Order your set of posters and cards today and be the reason someone smiles brighter tomorrow.

 Let's inspire and uplift together.
